game.name: Cave Story
game.desc: Cave Story is a beloved action-adventure platformer originally created solo by Daisuke "Pixel" Amaya over five years. This Mega Drive port brings the full story of Quote — a robot who wakes up with no memory in a cave filled with sentient creatures called Mimigas — to Sega's 16-bit hardware. Explore non-linear dungeons, collect weapons, and uncover a conspiracy in one of indie gaming's greatest classics.
